description:
We are Space Historians. 

Our team includes Fernando, a developer; Maria Fernanda and Maysa, who are students; and Sabrina, a marketing and content strategist who loves philosophy and neuroscience. We all share a passion for rock music, AI, and great stories. 

Together, we want to revive the stories of forgotten space explorers using creative storytelling and technology. 

We believe that every mission has a story to tell, and every discovery can inspire the next generation.
